QuestInfo.name: Leafre Winter Preparations
QuestInfo.0: Chief Tatamo in Leafre wants your help preparing for winter.
QuestInfo.1: Chief Tatamo of Leafre says that he must prepare for the approaching winter. He wants you to bring him the Hot Stones that can only be found in Leafre.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered the Hot Stones for Chief Tatamo. The Haflingers of Leafre should now have a warm winter.

0.0: What brings you to Leafre? Anyway, do you have any Hot Stones on you?\r\n#L0##bWhat is a Hot Stone?#l\n#k
0.1: You don't know what a Hot Stone is? You really are an outsider. There are stones that generate heat in Minar Forest. Maybe it's because of the magical barrier that surrounds the forest, but those stones can only be found there. We Halflingers carry Hot Stones in winter to keep warm. I was going to give some Hot Stones to the younger Halflingers this year. Can you help me?
